scientific_problem: P10 found positive lb7 conditional low-overlap alignment but local-neighbor matching was acquisition-cohort sensitive and partly composition-driven. P11 tests the frozen P10 grammar on a fresh reconstruction corpus selected before body outcomes are observed.

sampling_design.replacement_policy: no outcome-triggered replacement; retrieval failures remain failures and any replacement requires a separately presealed amendment before observing geometry

primary: lb7 conditional d<=2 TS solve-level excess among nonempty-support non-G1 states

replication_rule.replicated_direction: otherwise both fresh lb7 conditional solve excess > 0 and fresh exact lb7-vs-neighbor matched solve mean > 0

frozen_analysis.p_values: solve-clustered sign-flip diagnostics reported descriptively; no threshold required for directional replication verdict
